svg.title: Reporting a security problem
svg.desc: Report privately through the repository Security tab, choosing Report a vulnerability, and never in a public issue. Include the version, the operating system, and the steps, with real credentials removed. You get an acknowledgement within seven days. Especially useful findings: a repository command running without approval, Strict denying without local approval, a credential appearing in output or records, private content reaching the records, ship staging a file you did not name or pushing with force, a path outside the repository, and integrate changing settings ZeroTurn did not write.
svg.text: within seven days, and are told
Most useful findings: a repository command that runs without approval, Strict denying without local approval,
a credential in output or records, private content in the records, or ship staging a file you did not name.
